meta.name: team-stack
meta.description: Analyze a task, propose an agent team composition with roles and responsibilities, and create the team after user confirmation. Use when the user says "team stack", "create a team", "set up agents for this", or describes a complex task that would benefit from multiple agents working together.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析复杂任务并组建多智能体团队
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要多个智能体分工完成复杂任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze complex tasks and assemble multi-agent teams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need multiple agents to collaborate on complex tasks

howto.what: 当用户描述复杂任务时，Claude 会分析任务并提议一个由多个具有特定角色的 agent 组成的团队。用户确认后，Claude 创建该团队并分配任务给每个 agent，包含明确的输入和交付标准。
howto.when: 用户说出“team stack”、“create a team”、“set up agents for this”等关键词，或描述需要多个 agent 协作的复杂任务时触发。

say.text: 为这个新功能创建一个agent团队。
say.note: Claude 会分析任务并提议团队组成。

say.text: 分析这个bug修复任务，提出团队方案。
say.note: Claude 会基于代码库分析并提议团队。
Claude 会创建多个agent并行工作。

howto.what_en: When the user describes a complex task, Claude analyzes it and proposes a team of agents with specific roles. After user confirmation, Claude creates the team and assigns tasks to each agent with clear inputs and deliverables.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "team stack", "create a team", "set up agents for this", or describes a complex task that benefits from multiple agents.

say_en.text: Create an agent team for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the task and proposes a team.

say_en.text: Analyze this bugfix task and propose a team.
say_en.note: Claude explores the codebase and suggests agents.

say_en.text: Set up agents for this refactoring.
say_en.note: Claude creates multiple agents working concurrently.
